placements.why: This envelope's content is organizational-strategy grain about a system's design commitment — a ratified contract governing how an operation (remember) behaves end-to-end (dispatch, receipt, resolution). No strata category exists yet in this repo to hold architecture-level content, and nothing supplied is even close, so a standalone top-level category is warranted rather than forcing this under an unrelated name.
placements.title: System behavior is committed to as a ratified, operationally-enforced contract
placements.frame: What operational guarantee does this architectural decision lock in, and what concrete mechanism makes that guarantee true in practice?

placements.title: The async remember contract turns a blocking risk into a durable dispatch-and-resolve guarantee
placements.frame: What guarantee does the ratified async contract commit to, and by what concrete mechanism — dispatch, receipt, poll, or piggyback — is that guarantee actually satisfied?
placements.why: All three expressions trace one theme from three angles: the act of ratifying the contract, the invariants it locks in (no blocking, no lost work), and the concrete dispatch/poll/piggyback mechanism that satisfies those invariants — matching the position group's own framing. No existing leaf covers this (graph structure is empty), and the content is a directional statement about how the system's async behavior is guaranteed, not a one-time fact, so it names a subject future envelopes about this contract's evolution will keep feeding rather than a single measurement.
